title: 'Clarkson's Farm' special 'Jeremy Grows a Car' coming to Prime Video in 2027
summary: Jeremy Clarkson is going back to his automotive roots by building his own car using produce from his farm.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- Jeremy Grows a Car: A Clarkson's Farm Special


is coming to Prime Video in 2027.


- Jeremy Clarkson will attempt to grow and build a car from produce at Diddly Squat Farm.


- Legendary car designer Ian Callum is helping redesign a Jaguar for the special.


---


[Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/prime-video) has greenlit a brand-new special episode from the beloved


[Clarkson’s Farm](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/clarksons-farm-season-5-prime-video) franchise


,


titled


Jeremy Grows a Car: A Clarkson’s Farm Special


.


This stand-alone episode will see Jeremy go back to his automotive roots to undertake a world first: growing and building his very own car from produce grown at his Diddly Squat Farm.


Coming to Prime Video in 2027, here’s everything you need to know.


## What is ‘Jeremy Grows a Car: A Clarkson’s Farm Special’ about?


As one of the UK’s most famous farmers, Jeremy Clarkson has tried to grow it all: wheat and barley, potatoes and mushrooms, even wasabi. But never before has he tried to grow something this ambitious. In fact, no one has. Growing a car is not for the faint-hearted.


['Young Sherlock’ Season 2 is coming to Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/guy-ritchie-sherlock-holmes-young-sherlock-prime-video)


Guy Ritchie's 'Young Sherlock' is returning for Season 2 on Prime Video, with Hero Fiennes Tiffin back as the iconic detective.


Frustrated by modern motoring, Jeremy has decided that if he wants a new car, he won’t buy one—he’ll build one.


The base for his grand plan is the Jaguar F-Type V6S, a car he believes represents the sweet spot between analogue driving thrill and modern practicality. But this is no ordinary restoration job. Alongside using his very own Diddly leather interior and wool carpets, Jeremy will attempt to grow a crop of flax fiber, turning it into a revolutionary flax-composite—a sustainable alternative to carbon fiber that is already catching the attention of major car makers.


With the help of legendary car designer Ian Callum CBE, founder of design and engineering firm CALLUM, the man who penned the original F-Type and the Aston Martin Vanquish, Jeremy’s redesigned Jaguar will feature everything he believes the iconic British brand should stand for: style, luxury, and performance.


## How to watch ‘Jeremy Grows a Car: A Clarkson’s Farm Special’ on Prime Video


This one-off special will be released exclusively on Prime Video in more than 240 countries and territories worldwide in 2027.
